notes:
Annotations you erased staying erased, and transfers that used to get stuck.

**Erased annotations could come back on the second tablet.** Old markings you had rubbed out a while ago could reappear on the paired tablet, then vanish again when you closed and reopened the piece. Nothing was ever wrong with your saved annotations — the second tablet was drawing an out-of-date snapshot over the page. It now keeps that snapshot in step.

**Transfers that got stuck and never finished.** When the first tablet was still building a large piece to send, the second tablet stopped setting itself any deadline at all. If the go-ahead message went missing along the way — and these messages are sent without acknowledgement — the receiving tablet would wait forever. It now waits a generous but finite amount of time and gets on with it.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
